description: The only Clay tool that can build a table, not just read one.

novel_features.name: Table blueprint export
novel_features.description: Snapshot a table's entire column graph to portable JSON you can commit to git.

novel_features.name: Table blueprint apply
novel_features.description: Rebuild a captured table design in a new workbook, remapping formula references automatically.

novel_features.name: Column dependency graph
novel_features.description: Show which columns feed which, resolved from formula field references.

novel_features.name: Broken-reference doctor
novel_features.description: Find formulas pointing at deleted columns and columns nothing consumes.

novel_features.name: Enrichment provider compare
novel_features.description: Rank enrichment providers for a job and flag which ones your workspace can actually run today.

novel_features.name: Table schema diff
novel_features.description: Structurally compare two tables' column graphs, including formulas and enrichment bindings.

novel_features.name: Enrichment run watch
novel_features.description: Block until every column's enrichment runs settle, reporting per-column status counts.

novel_features.name: Cross-table lookup column
novel_features.description: Connect two tables by creating a lookup column that pulls the matching row from another table on a join key.

novel_features.name: Workbook topology graph
novel_features.description: Show how every table and CSV source in a workbook feeds the others, with each table's credit estimate.

novel_features.name: Formula edit in place
novel_features.description: Read a column's current formula with references resolved to column names, edit it, and write it back.

novel_features.name: Typed error surfacing
novel_features.description: Report why columns failed, combining Clay's structured validation errors with per-column run status counts.

novel_features.name: Row read with column names
novel_features.description: Read table rows with generated field ids resolved to real column names, optionally filtered by cell run status.

novel_features.name: AI formula generation with column resolution
novel_features.description: Turn a natural-language prompt into a Clay formula that references the target table's real columns.
